006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import java.util.Locale;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * FOTY: Exceptions related to type errors.
017 */
018public class InvalidTypeFunctionException
019    extends FunctionMetapathError {
020  @NonNull
021  private static final String PREFIX = "FOTY";
022  /**
023   * <a href=
024   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOTY0012">err:FOTY0012</a>:
025   * Raised by
026   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-data">fn:data</a>, or
027   * by implicit atomization, if applied to a node with no typed value, the main
028   * example being an element validated against a complex type that defines it to
029   * have element-only content.
030   */
031  public static final int NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE = 12;
032
033  /**
034   * <a href=
035   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOTY0013">err:FOTY0013</a>:
036   * Raised by
037   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-data">fn:data</a>, or
038   * by implicit atomization, if the sequence to be atomized contains a function
039   * item.
040   */
041  public static final int DATA_ITEM_IS_FUNCTION = 13;
042  /**
043   * <a href=
044   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOTY0014">err:FOTY0014</a>:
045   * Raised by fn:string, or by implicit string conversion, if the input sequence
046   * contains a function item.
047   */
048  public static final int ARGUMENT_TO_STRING_IS_FUNCTION = 14;
049
050  /**
051   * the serial version UUID.
052   */
053  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
057   * no cause.
058   *
059   * @param code
060   *          the error code value
061   * @param item
062   *          the item the exception applies to
063   */
064  public InvalidTypeFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IItem item) {
065    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), generateMessage(item));
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
070   * {@code cause}.
071   *
072   * @param code
073   *          the error code value
074   * @param item
075   *          the item the exception applies to
076   * @param cause
077   *          the original exception cause
078   */
079  public InvalidTypeFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IItem item, Throwable cause) {
080    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), generateMessage(item), cause);
081  }
082
083  private static String generateMessage(@NonNull IItem item) {
084    String retval;
085    if (item instanceof INodeItem) {
086      INodeItem nodeItem = (INodeItem) item;
087      retval = String.format("The %s node item at path '%s' has no typed value",
088          nodeItem.getNodeItemKind().name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
089          nodeItem.getMetapath());
090    } else {
091      retval = String.format("Item '%s' has an improperly typed value", item.getClass().getName());
092    }
093    return retval;
094  }
095}
